verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents running the entire stack on any OS with a Docker CLI (or Kubernetes via a Helm chart), and its CLI can target a self-hosted endpoint. Functions are pitched as 'develop locally, deploy when ready', and Cloud/self-hosted migration offers a path from a local instance to deployment. An independent early tester praised the containerized offline-dev setup, and another user said it is easy to install for home projects. Missing for 10: a dedicated local-dev command or emulator workflow (e.g. a one-command local start), explicit docs on promoting a local setup to production, and recent hands-on corroboration of the local-dev experience.
